findings.observation: The trained hinge margin0.6 is active for~99.95% of anchors over all50 epoch averages for both controls; detached margin0.3 probe is active for only part of the same batches.

findings.implication: The main loss stays active, so small improvement is not explained by zero hinge gradient. This does not prove the margin causes poor generalization.
findings.next_step: Audit previous margin trials; if Q fails, separately measure CE versus metric gradients on selected deploy paths before repeating or tuning margins.
